bullets.text: Chelsea Stadium Gets Mobile Boost - **Virgin Media O2** enhances connectivity for fans at Stamford Bridge with new mobile infrastructure.
Ofcom's Spectrum Split Plan - **Ofcom** proposes dividing the 6 GHz band for mobile and Wi-Fi, enabling shared spectrum use.
AI Investment Surge - **KPMG** report reveals 84% of telecom CEOs expect positive ROI from AI within three years.
Single-Server vRAN Success - **Samsung** and **Intel** demonstrate single-server vRAN viability, reducing hardware sprawl for operators.
FWA Market Expansion - Fixed Wireless Access subscriptions projected to exceed 191 million by 2029, driven by 5G technologies.
Brady's Labelling Solutions - **Brady** updates mobile labelling printers to enhance telecom network maintenance efficiency.
NEC Exits RAN Market - **NEC** halts 4G/5G base station development amid competitive pressures, shifting focus to specialized applications.
AI-RAN Delivers ROI - **AI-RAN** technology offers operational efficiencies and energy savings for telecom operators.
